summary: Default display precision was too high for the stated semi-technical donor audience (one-decimal million tonnes, two-decimal shares), costing a full correction round.
evidence: m7, r6, r7; SIMS/co2-A/feedback/human.md #1; SIMS/co2-A/human/notes.md turn 7
tag_reason: Package export defaults and the headline checkpoint would produce the same precision for any real user with this brief.

summary: check-draft cannot trace presentation transforms (Mt to billion tonnes, approximate wording), so a cosmetic rounding request required a new recorded analytical result with seven validations.
tag_reason: The number checker and result contract are shipped helpers; any host hits this when a user asks for rounded or rescaled wording.

summary: The skill, template and guide reading load is heavy; combined reads were truncated and re-read, and the full-draft turn spent about 7 minutes before its first review.
evidence: agent-001, agent-005, agent-006 logs; SIMS/co2-A/feedback/agent.md #2; reviewloop first review at 7.3 min of 10.4
tag_reason: The length and spread of the released skills and package contract drive this on any host, though truncation limits vary by agent.

summary: The agent linked the user to the agent-only awb-scope SKILL.md to justify asking scoping questions.
tag_reason: The agent cited its instruction file in user-facing text, which a real user would also see; the user did not open it.

summary: Replies repeated content because interim narration and the final summary overlapped (the scoping questions twice, 'all five accepted' twice).
tag_reason: The relay shows interim messages as an interactive Codex session does, so a real user sees the same duplication.

summary: The awb-status reply came back as prose without the one-screen layout or suggested next requests the user expected from the README.
tag_reason: This concerns how the status skill's output is presented to the user, independent of the harness.

summary: Workbench-internal vocabulary and result IDs leaked into chat and the headline preview ('cohort checks', 'shared dataset owid_co2', 'Primary result: territorial-change').
tag_reason: The preview template and skill wording put these labels in user-facing material.

summary: The headline preview the user must review is stored in a hidden .preview folder.
tag_reason: The folder location is set by the package workflow, not the harness.

summary: Links switched between absolute paths and relative paths that may not open from the user's terminal.
tag_reason: This may be Codex reply style rather than skill guidance; the skills' link conventions were not inspected.

summary: No materiality threshold was proposed for the Q2 'reduced emissions' count; the user had to ask for the at-least-5% version, costing an exchange.
tag_reason: Scoping guidance determines whether such thresholds are proposed up front, on any host.

summary: The chat said the Q2 chart used 'the same ten countries', but with the 38-country threshold four countries changed (Spain, Netherlands, Czechia, Belgium in place of Canada, Mexico, Australia, Poland); the slide text itself is correct.
tag_reason: The deliverable is right and the inaccuracy is in the model's chat summary, so it is unclear whether the skills contribute.

summary: The MCP read tool advertises a shared settings field, but the profile command rejects it ('unknown arguments: settings').
tag_reason: This is a mismatch in the shipped MCP schema and helper.

summary: check-draft's name checker flagged the ordinary prose word 'coal-share' as leaked internal result ID.
tag_reason: This is a false positive in the shipped check-draft helper.

summary: Read-only check-draft preflight returns an error for expected lifecycle state (no inventory yet, stale receipt after edits), mixing expected steps with real defects and showing up as MCP failures.
tag_reason: The exit semantics belong to the shipped helper and MCP server.

summary: Status reported state as out of date because history was one second newer, though all evidence was current.
tag_reason: This comes from the shipped status collector's timestamp logic.

summary: The init-to-scope handoff requires the interview before investigation records exist, so a fully specified brief had to be parked in the project README.
tag_reason: This sequencing is defined by the released init and scope skills.

summary: The acquisition register needed manual completion of Restrictions, and acquisition prose stayed phrased as planned after retention succeeded.
tag_reason: This is the behavior of the landing and retention helpers.

summary: The package produces a slide manuscript, chart CSVs and assembly instructions rather than a rendered PPTX, which adds work for the user before the deadline.
tag_reason: The package output scope is a product decision; the README states it, but the gap remains.

summary: 'About 8 slides' became 10 assembled slides (8 main, 1 appendix, 1 divider) because of the required slide set and the builder's divider.
tag_reason: The deck rules and builder divider are shipped package-format behavior; it was disclosed and the user accepted.

summary: The fresh full review flagged a donor-note tolerance phrase under a fine-grained editorial rule, forcing a second (scoped) review round of about 2 minutes; no perfectionism loop otherwise (at most 2 rounds per request).
evidence: agent-006 review records at 8.4 and 9.3 min; kit/reviewloop.py output; SIMS/co2-A/feedback/agent.md section 2
tag_reason: The review rule and the receipt workflow are part of the released package skill.

summary: The README is long, mixes install/MCP admin with analyst guidance, explains the two headline-checkpoint modes unclearly, and says nothing on display precision or whether cleaning is automatic.
tag_reason: This concerns the released README, the only user documentation.

summary: zsh heredocs failed because temp files could not be created, and git (xcrun) and pip could not write their caches in the sandbox.
tag_reason: This is caused by the Codex workspace-write sandbox and simulated home, not by the release.

summary: reviewloop.py counts 0 reviewer subagents because Codex logs only collab 'wait' items, not spawn items; three read-only reviewers actually ran.
tag_reason: This is a measurement gap in the simulation kit's log parser.

summary: The harness scratchpad path embeds the host account's name slug; because the user gave it as the storage location, it appears in the project README, foundation/sources.md, a review snapshot and compiled files (not in the release or storage).
tag_reason: This comes from where the harness places the simulation, not from the product.

summary: The persona volunteered scope facts (the territorial definition, the country definition, the ISO/Kosovo concern) before the agent asked, which thinned the scoping interview.
tag_reason: This is the known persona front-loading study limit, kept for comparability.
